title: Add frontend snapshot controls
description: Add payroll UI controls for live vs snapshot mode, snapshot list/selection, capture current data, and active snapshot indicator. Propagate selected source to payroll actions.
convergence: User can switch between Live and Snapshot data in Payroll tab.
User can capture current live payroll into a named snapshot.
User can select an existing snapshot for the period.
Automation/export/reset actions receive source and snapshotId.
